source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

jungle.quote: Open with Imperial Lash to root the target and dash in, then Iron Rose and Royal Flourish to hold them while your basic attacks hit. Once Mutilator joins Alternator around minute 16, save Queen's Garden for when they try to run.
jungle.issue: Iron Rose does not hold enemies; it is a damage-reduction shield plus a damage vine
jungle.rewrite: Open with Imperial Lash to root the target and dash in, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize them and Iron Rose to take less damage while you hit. Once Mutilator joins Alternator around minute 16, save Queen's Garden for when they try to run.

offlane.quote: Drop Bramble Patch to slow them, then throw Harvest Nettles, since each repeat hit on one target grows, and toss Untamed Growth where they will walk. Once Combustion and Wraith Leggings are done around minute 16, use Fly Trap to pull grouped enemies.
offlane.issue: unclear English: 'each repeat hit grows' (the damage grows)
offlane.rewrite: Drop Bramble Patch to slow them, then throw Harvest Nettles, since repeat hits on one target deal more damage, and toss Untamed Growth where they will walk. Once Combustion and Wraith Leggings are done around minute 16, use Fly Trap to pull grouped enemies.

offlane.quote: When a diver jumps you, drop Bramble Patch at your feet and walk back; you have no dash, so standing your ground loses.
offlane.issue: 'diver' is jargon a new player may not know
offlane.rewrite: When an enemy jumps on you, drop Bramble Patch at your feet and walk back; you have no dash, so standing your ground loses.
